### Submission Checklist

- [ ] I created my project in a separate GitHub repository.

- [ ] I opened a pull request from my assignment branch into main.
- [ ] I kept the code review pull request open for mentor review.
- [ ] My project uses the required technologies.
- [ ] All required routes and features work correctly.
- [ ] My project repository includes a professional README.
- [ ] My project is deployed if deployment is required.
- [ ] I added only my own submission file.
